output.tuning_notes: Baseline approved ETL tools, hosts and service accounts and exclude them. Prioritise hits on hosts or accounts that do not normally run data engineering workloads, hits shortly after new logons or EC2 creation, and first-time function creation by a user. Remove very broad terms like dbt if noisy, and adjust the ActionType list to the connectors that ingest your cloud logs.

CloudAppEvents ingests AWS or Azure activity via Defender for Cloud Apps connectors with ActionType values similar to API names
Sentinel AWS tables are not in the allowed list, so CloudAppEvents is the closest cloud table and may have limited AWS coverage
